result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection that lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, creating a hostile environment for walking. While sidewalks are present, the large crossing distance and lack of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure prioritize vehicle throughput over safety.

hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane width of the street increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, high-speed urban arterial with multiple travel lanes and overhead highway-style signage. Despite the presence of sidewalks and a signalized intersection, there are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, creating a highly hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without guidance.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the center of the image

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The roadway is extremely wide, requiring pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge island.

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and overhead highway signage encourage high vehicle speeds, which increases the risk of severe injury in a collision.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide dedicated and predictable crossing phases.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages, reducing exposure time.
